layout: 2 x 2, equal square cells: neutral, casting, victory, hurt

prompts.alice:
Create a transparent PNG game portrait expression atlas, square canvas with EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. No text, no dividers, no labels, no background, genuine alpha transparency. Use attached image as STYLE AND FRAMING REFERENCE: refined Japanese GBA-era pixel art bust, visible chunky square pixels, natural stepped outline, restrained soft palette, warm skin, large expressive eyes, confident hand-placed pixel clusters. NOT smooth illustration, NOT 3D, NOT cross-stitch. Each portrait should look drawn at approximately 80 by 88 actual pixels then cleanly enlarged with nearest-neighbor, not a high-res painting with a pixel filter. Portrait from upper chest upwards, full hair/headwear, slight three-quarter view facing viewer-right. Center one portrait inside each cell, same registration/scale, 5 percent transparent padding all sides, flat cut along chest near bottom of cell. Preserve identical hairstyle, silhouette, costume, pose and lighting in all four cells. Change only eyebrows, eyelids, eyes, mouth and subtle cheek color. Cell order: top-left composed neutral small smile; top-right focused determined spellcasting with brows angled and mouth firmly speaking; bottom-left pleased confident victory smile; bottom-right startled/strained hit reaction, slightly wide eyes and small open mouth, NOT injured/gore. Face differences must read at small display size.
Character: Alice Margatroid from Touhou. Match the reference particularly closely: chin-length golden blonde bob, red headband, blue eyes, blue dress, white shoulder capelet with TWO red trim lines and scalloped white edge, large red bow at throat. No witch hat, no maid apron. Keep recognizable proper Alice outfit.
